page.notes: The last line ends with "D v." and the catchword "muro" below it; I have read "muro" as the catchword. The glyph in "Trophęum" is uncertain as to the cedilla under e. The word "Tropheum" shows a ligature-like mark. Line "Plemmeriū" shows the tilde over u for -um.
